data.name: Alice
data.message: Just finished weapons task, heading to security for cameras. Want to buddy up?

data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to electrical for a task, want to come with?

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Hey Alice, doing cameras here. Want to buddy up after?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Sure Charlie, let's buddy up. After cameras I need to do electrical then storage.

data.name: Bob
data.message: Doing submit scan, want to buddy up after?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Cameras done, heading to electrical next. Come with?

data.name: Bob
data.message: One more tick on scan, then I'm heading to security or weapons - want to come?

data.name: Diana
data.message: Sure, I'll come. Let me grab cafeteria on the way - heading to weapons works for me.

I found Frank's body in electrical. I'll give you my route: I started in weapons, where I saw Eve come in from security at tick 4. Then I moved to security, where I saw Charlie arrive from navigation at tick 6 and he was still there through tick 8. Then I moved into electrical and at the same moment Bob walked in from medbay — and Frank's body was already there on the floor.

So Bob arrived in electrical the same tick I did, coming from medbay. Frank was already dead when we got there, so either Bob killed him just before stepping out and came back, or someone else was in electrical before us. Diana is the one I haven't seen at all this round, which is also worth noting.

I'd like to hear from Bob about why he came to electrical, and from Diana about her whole route. Charlie has a partial alibi with me for ticks 6-8 in security.

I can confirm Alice's account from my side. I came from navigation into security at tick 6, and Alice was already there with me through ticks 6 and 7. At tick 8 she left security heading toward electrical, and I stayed in security doing my camera task — that's where the meeting caught me.

So Alice and I vouch for each other from tick 6 through 8. Neither of us could have been in electrical killing Frank during that window.

That leaves Bob and Diana as the main suspects. Bob walking into electrical from medbay exactly when Alice arrived is suspicious — he could've killed Frank, stepped into medbay briefly, then come back. And Diana is completely unaccounted for. I want to hear both their routes before I commit to a vote, but right now Bob and Diana are who we need to focus on.

My route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical. I started in oxygen, moved to upper engine, then into medbay, and from medbay I stepped into electrical — which is when Alice arrived from cafeteria and we found Frank's body together.

Here's the important part: while I was in medbay at ticks 7 and 8, Diana was there with me. And critically, at tick 7 I watched Diana ENTER medbay FROM electrical. So Diana was in electrical just before tick 7, then moved into medbay. That timing lines up very suspiciously with Frank's death — she could easily have killed Frank in electrical and then walked into medbay to establish an alibi with me.

I didn't kill Frank. I came from medbay into electrical at the same tick Alice came from cafeteria, and the body was already there. Diana is the one who was actually in electrical right before the body was found.

Diana, I need to hear your route — specifically what you were doing in electrical before tick 7.

I'll share my route: I started in security, moved to weapons, then to cafeteria — that's where the meeting was called. I was nowhere near electrical.

One thing I can add: Alice said she saw me come into weapons from security at tick 4. That matches my route exactly, so Alice's account is consistent with what I actually did. That gives Alice some credibility as a truthful reporter.

Now on the main question: Bob's accusation against Diana is serious and specific — he claims he saw Diana enter medbay from electrical at tick 7. If that's true, Diana was in electrical right before the body was found, which is the most direct evidence we have.

But we should be careful. Bob himself walked into electrical the same tick Alice did, and his story conveniently puts Diana in the killer's spot. It's a classic "I have a witness, and I'm accusing my witness" setup — which could go either way. Either Bob is telling the truth and Diana killed Frank, or Bob killed Frank and is framing Diana.

The key tiebreaker is Diana's testimony. If Diana confirms she was in medbay with Bob at ticks 7-8, then one of them killed Frank and is lying about the prior movement. If Diana denies being in medbay at all, then Bob is clearly lying and he's our duck.

Diana, please give us your exact route tick by tick.

This is a really tough spot for me, and I'm going to be completely honest about my route because lying will only make it worse.

My route was: electrical → medbay → electrical → medbay → cafeteria.

Yes, I was in electrical and medbay multiple times — I was bouncing between them because I had a wiring task in electrical that I couldn't finish in one go, and I cut through medbay between attempts. Bob is correct that I was in medbay with him at tick 8. And yes, I was in electrical before that.

But here's what's important: at tick 5, I watched Frank leave medbay heading INTO electrical. And at tick 6, Frank was alive in electrical with me. I left electrical after that and went back to medbay, where Bob was.

Now think about this carefully. Bob says he came oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical. But if Bob was in medbay at tick 7 watching me come in from electrical, then Bob walked into electrical at the SAME tick as Alice — meaning the body was placed there between when I left and when Bob/Alice arrived. Who else had access to electrical in that window?

Bob is framing me with a very specific, very convenient story. He's the one whose route ends in the body room, and he's the one pointing fingers at the person he shared medbay with.

I didn't kill Frank. I think Bob did it on his way through, then walked back to medbay to establish me as his alibi-turned-scapegoat. I'm voting Bob.

Thanks everyone for laying out routes. Let me think through this carefully because the situation has narrowed nicely.

What I can confirm directly: Eve coming into weapons from security at tick 4 — confirmed. Charlie in security from tick 6 through 8 — confirmed, we vouch for each other. Bob walking into electrical from medbay at tick 10, same tick I arrived from cafeteria, with Frank's body already on the floor — confirmed.

Now, Bob and Diana's stories actually agree on a lot: both place themselves in medbay together around ticks 7-8, and both agree Diana was in electrical before that. The disagreement is about WHO was in electrical at the moment Frank died.

Diana says Frank was alive with her in electrical at tick 6, then she left for medbay. If that's true, Frank died sometime between tick 6 and tick 10 — and during that window, Bob was in medbay (ticks 7-8) before walking into electrical at tick 10. That means Bob walking into electrical at tick 10 IS the moment he could have killed Frank... except Frank's body was already there when I arrived the same tick.

So someone killed Frank between tick 6 (Diana's last sighting of him alive) and tick 10. Diana was in medbay with Bob during part of that window. If Bob can confirm Diana was with him continuously from tick 7 to tick 10, that actually clears Diana — because she couldn't have been in electrical killing Frank.

Bob, can you confirm: was Diana in medbay with you the ENTIRE time from tick 7 until you left for electrical at tick 10? If yes, Diana has an alibi and we need to look elsewhere. If there's a gap, then Diana is suspect.

I'm not ready to commit my vote yet — I want Bob to answer that specific question.

I already shared my route and what I saw, so let me focus on analyzing what's been said since.

Diana and Bob's stories actually overlap a lot — both agree they were in medbay together around ticks 7-8, and both agree Diana came from electrical. The disagreement is about timing and who had the opportunity to kill Frank.

Diana's claim that Frank was alive with her in electrical at tick 6 is important. If true, that means Frank died between tick 6 and tick 10. During that window:
- Diana was in electrical (tick 6), then medbay (tick 7-8), then back to electrical, then medbay, then cafeteria
- Bob claims he was in medbay ticks 7-8, then walked into electrical at tick 10

Diana's route has her bouncing back into electrical AFTER the medbay visit with Bob. That's a window where she could have killed Frank without Bob seeing.

But Bob's route is also suspicious — he conveniently ends up at the body the same moment as Alice.

Like Alice, I want Bob to answer her specific question: was Diana in medbay with you continuously from tick 7 to tick 10? And Diana — when exactly did you go back to electrical the second time, and was Frank's body already there?

I'm leaning slightly toward Diana right now because her route puts her in electrical multiple times in the kill window, but I want those answers before I lock in my vote.

My route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical. To answer Alice's direct question: Diana was in medbay with me at tick 7 and tick 8. I moved into electrical at tick 9-10, arriving the same tick Alice did from cafeteria.

Here's the critical detail I need to clarify, because Diana's testimony just gave her away: Diana claims her route was electrical → medbay → electrical → medbay → cafeteria. But I was in medbay at ticks 7 and 8, and Diana was with me BOTH those ticks. She did NOT leave medbay and go back to electrical a second time while I was there. If she went back to electrical, it had to be AFTER tick 8 — which is exactly the window when Frank was killed.

So Diana's own route admits she returned to electrical in the kill window. She's placing herself at the scene at the right time, then trying to spin it as innocent task work.

Also, Diana says "Bob walked into electrical the same tick as Alice — meaning the body was placed there between when I left and when Bob/Alice arrived." That's her trying to frame the timing, but it actually confirms MY story: I came from medbay into electrical at tick 10 and the body was already there. I had no kill cooldown opportunity — I was with Diana in medbay the whole time before that.

Diana had the means, the opportunity, and her route literally loops back through the crime scene during the kill window. I'm voting Diana.

This is genuinely a hard call between Bob and Diana, and I want to lay out the logic clearly because we can't afford a wrong vote.

Both agree they were together in medbay at ticks 7-8. Both agree Diana came from electrical before that. The dispute is about Diana's SECOND trip to electrical.

Diana's route: electrical → medbay → electrical → medbay → cafeteria. That second electrical visit had to happen between tick 8 (leaving medbay with Bob) and tick 10 (meeting called in cafeteria). That's a very tight window — essentially she'd have to leave medbay, enter electrical, kill Frank, leave electrical, return to medbay, and then go to cafeteria, all in 1-2 ticks. That's logistically very tight given travel times.

Meanwhile, Bob's route ends with him walking into the body room at the exact tick Alice arrives. If Bob killed Frank, he'd need to have done it before going to medbay — but he claims he came from upper engine, not electrical. Unless he's lying about that leg of his route.

Here's what tips me: Diana volunteered her full bouncing route honestly, including admitting she was in electrical multiple times. A duck trying to hide would simplify their route, not complicate it. Bob's accusation is very polished and specific — "I watched Diana enter medbay FROM electrical at tick 7" — which is exactly the kind of detail a duck would fabricate to frame their medbay buddy.

But Diana's second electrical loop IS suspicious timing-wise.

I'm genuinely torn, but I'll lean Bob — his story conveniently puts him at the body with a witness (Alice) while pointing at the one person who can't contradict his medbay narrative. Classic duck framing pattern. I'm voting Bob, but I want to hear Diana's final response on the exact ticks of her second electrical trip.

Thank you, Eve — and I want to address the timing question directly because it's the crux of this.

My second trip to electrical happened at tick 9. I left medbay at tick 9, stepped into electrical to try to finish my wiring task, saw Frank's body already on the floor, panicked, and immediately went back through medbay toward cafeteria where the meeting was called. I should have reported it — that's on me, I froze. But I did NOT kill Frank. The body was already there when I walked in the second time.

Now think about what that means. If Frank's body was already in electrical at tick 9 when I walked in, then Frank was killed BEFORE tick 9. During ticks 7-8, Bob and I were together in medbay — neither of us could have done it then. So Frank was killed at tick 6 or earlier... which is exactly when Bob claims he was transiting oxygen → upper engine → medbay.

Here's the problem with Bob's route: oxygen to upper engine to medbay is a clean path that AVOIDS electrical entirely. But Bob has no witnesses for ticks 4-6. He could just as easily have gone oxygen → upper engine → electrical (killing Frank) → medbay, and then lied about the middle leg. Nobody saw him in upper engine. Nobody can confirm he didn't detour through electrical.

Meanwhile, I had Frank ALIVE with me at tick 6 in electrical. If I were the killer, why would I volunteer that I was in electrical multiple times? I'd hide it.

Bob is the duck. He's framing me because we shared medbay and he knows I can't disprove his upper engine claim. I'm voting Bob.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Heading to storage to sort cargo, want to come with?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Heading to storage via medbay, want to come Charlie?

I just walked into storage from medbay and found Charlie's body right here. Alice came in right after me — she entered from medbay too, just one tick behind. I didn't see who killed Charlie, but Alice was very close behind him on the same path. I was in medbay before this and didn't see anything suspicious there. Alice, what were you doing? You were trailing Charlie the whole way.

Wait, Diana, that's not quite right. Let me lay out my route clearly: I was in electrical doing tasks — I saw Charlie come into electrical from security at tick 13, and Bob was in electrical with me before he got voted last meeting. After that I moved from electrical to medbay, then medbay to storage. I wasn't "trailing" Charlie — he was alive and well in electrical when I last saw him.

Also, Diana, you say you came from medbay to storage and found the body immediately. But I came through medbay too and into storage right behind you. If Charlie was killed in storage, you would have been the one in the room with him first — I walked in and saw you standing over the body.

With Bob already ejected last meeting and only three of us alive, one of us two is the Duck. I know I didn't kill Charlie. Eve was off in weapons earlier and I haven't seen her near storage at all. Diana, your story puts you at the scene first. I'm suspicious of you.

Okay, here's what I know. My route was weapons → cafeteria → oxygen. I was nowhere near storage and didn't encounter anyone the whole round — which unfortunately means I can't vouch for either of you.

So it comes down to Diana vs Alice. Diana, you admit you walked into storage first and found the body. Alice says she came in right behind you. That means whoever entered storage *first* had the opportunity — and by Diana's own account, that was Diana.

Alice's story about being in electrical and then moving medbay → storage is consistent with the map. Diana's account places her at the scene first with the body.

Also worth noting: we ejected Bob last meeting and Frank/Charlie are dead. If Bob was the Duck, all tasks should be completing and we'd be winning — but we're still here with a body, so Bob was likely innocent. That means the Duck is still among us three.

I didn't kill Charlie. Diana was first on the body. I'm voting Diana.

Okay, I need to push back hard here because Eve is twisting the timeline. Let me clarify: Charlie entered storage from medbay at tick 16, and Alice came in right after at tick 17. I was already in storage when Charlie arrived — I didn't find a body and then Alice walked in, Charlie walked in alive, and then Alice followed him in. If I were the killer, why would I report with Alice standing right there as a witness? That makes no sense.

Think about it: Alice has been trailing Charlie's exact path — electrical → medbay → storage, one step behind him the whole way. That's a classic stalking pattern. She had the opportunity in medbay too, before storage.

And Eve — your route conveniently has zero witnesses. Weapons → cafeteria → oxygen, "didn't encounter anyone." That's an unverifiable alibi. You could have been anywhere.

I reported the body because I'm not the Duck. A Duck doesn't call a meeting on themselves with a witness present. My vote is on Alice — she was on Charlie's tail the entire round.

Diana, your new story has shifted significantly. In your first speech you said "I just walked into storage from medbay and found Charlie's body right here. Alice came in right after me — she entered from medbay too, just one tick behind." Now suddenly you were "already in storage when Charlie arrived" and he walked in alive? Those are two completely different timelines, and that contradiction is damning.

Let me restate my route clearly: electrical (with Bob and Charlie) → medbay → storage. I saw Charlie last in electrical at tick 13. I did NOT follow him to storage — I went through medbay. When I arrived in storage, Diana was already there with Charlie's body.

Eve's logic is sound: whoever was in storage first had the opportunity, and by Diana's own original admission, that was her. The fact that Diana is now rewriting her timeline mid-meeting to put Charlie arriving after her is a huge red flag.

Eve's alibi being "unverifiable" doesn't make her guilty — mine has the same problem for the medbay leg. But Diana is the one who keeps changing her story.

I'm voting Diana.

Diana's timeline shift is the deciding factor for me. Her first speech was clear: she walked into storage and found Charlie's body, and Alice came in right behind her. Now she's claiming Charlie walked in alive after her, and Alice followed. Those two versions can't both be true, and innocent players don't rewrite the crime scene mid-meeting.

Alice's route (electrical → medbay → storage) has been consistent from the start. Diana's hasn't.

I'm sticking with my vote: Diana.
